data:
{"operationName":"getPersonalizedContent","variables":{"userId":-1,"caller":"MP_HEADER_WEB","moduleSource":"PRODUCT_RECENT_CATEGORIES"},"query":"query getPersonalizedContent($userId: Int!, $caller: Caller!, $moduleSource: ModuleSource!) @hash(value: "a5331946851e425669fb65b17a1466500b45a3cd5f821aed3dfe71f4bb43d35c") {
  recentlyViewedData: getHugedeerFeedCards(
    type: RECENTLY_VIEWED
    userId: $userId
    caller: $caller
  ) {
    items {
      cardType
      cardTitle
      cardMetadata
      cardAttribute {
        categoryId
        styleId
        topicId
        photoLabelId
        proBadgeId
        itemId
        coverPhotoId
        __typename
      }
      products {
        title
        id
        preferredListingId
        isBuyable
        quantity
        listingPrice {
          currency
          basePrice
          previousPrice
          currentPrice
          basePriceTrade
          previousPriceTrade
          currentPriceTrade
          __typename
        }
        images @first(n: 1) {
          imageId
          externalId
          contentModified
          whiteBg
          width
          height
          __typename
        }
        productBadges {
          bestSellerOfTopics {
            topicId
            topicName
            rank
            topicUrl
            __typename
          }
          houzzCurated {
            topicUrl
            topicName
            topicId
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        productStatus
        listingStatus
        reviewScore
        numReviews
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  continueBrowsingData: getHugedeerCategoryRecommendation(
    userId: $userId
    caller: $caller
    moduleSource: $moduleSource
  ) {
    categoryId
    topicId
    topicName
    browseUrl
    image {
      imageId
      externalId
      contentModified
      whiteBg
      width
      height
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"getPersonalizedContent","variables":{"userId":85641735,"caller":"MP_HEADER_WEB","moduleSource":"PRODUCT_RECENT_CATEGORIES"},"query":"query getPersonalizedContent($userId: Int!, $caller: Caller!, $moduleSource: ModuleSource!) @hash(value: "a5331946851e425669fb65b17a1466500b45a3cd5f821aed3dfe71f4bb43d35c") {
  recentlyViewedData: getHugedeerFeedCards(
    type: RECENTLY_VIEWED
    userId: $userId
    caller: $caller
  ) {
    items {
      cardType
      cardTitle
      cardMetadata
      cardAttribute {
        categoryId
        styleId
        topicId
        photoLabelId
        proBadgeId
        itemId
        coverPhotoId
        __typename
      }
      products {
        title
        id
        preferredListingId
        isBuyable
        quantity
        listingPrice {
          currency
          basePrice
          previousPrice
          currentPrice
          basePriceTrade
          previousPriceTrade
          currentPriceTrade
          __typename
        }
        images @first(n: 1) {
          imageId
          externalId
          contentModified
          whiteBg
          width
          height
          __typename
        }
        productBadges {
          bestSellerOfTopics {
            topicId
            topicName
            rank
            topicUrl
            __typename
          }
          houzzCurated {
            topicUrl
            topicName
            topicId
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        productStatus
        listingStatus
        reviewScore
        numReviews
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  continueBrowsingData: getHugedeerCategoryRecommendation(
    userId: $userId
    caller: $caller
    moduleSource: $moduleSource
  ) {
    categoryId
    topicId
    topicName
    browseUrl
    image {
      imageId
      externalId
      contentModified
      whiteBg
      width
      height
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}
